title: alcea kurdica var. schirazana
intro: Alcea kurdica var. schirazana, commonly known as the Persian hollyhock, is a plant species within the mallow family that has been traditionally used in folk medicine. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Alcea kurdica var. schirazana are attributed to its ability to reduce oxidative stress, modulate the immune system, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
